name: Ontario Non-Resident Speculation Tax (25%)
description: Foreign nationals, foreign corporations and taxable trustees pay 25% of the value of consideration on residential property (one to six single-family residences) anywhere in Ontario, in addition to land transfer tax.

attributes.property: land with one to six single family residences; condo parking/storage units designated since 2024-03-27
exemptions: spouse of a Canadian citizen or permanent resident
rebates: Permanent-resident rebate if the buyer becomes a PR within four years of registration (application within 180 days of becoming PR)
attributes.international_student_or_worker_rebate: not mentioned on the current page
